target_audience: Recreational and commercial skippers, boat owners, marine navigators in NZ and AU
theme: Marine High-Contrast Light/Dark sunlight readable PWA

touch_and_accessibility.sunlight_readability: High-contrast borders (1.5px solid), crisp typography, clear visual status indicators
touch_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: Mandatory data-testid attribute on all interactive inputs, buttons, checklist checkboxes, tabs, emergency triggers, and export actions

boat_details_bar.validation: Must prompt or require filling before checklist edits, exports, or emergency calls
boat_details_bar.gps_display: Degrees-Minutes live GPS position indicator e.g. 36° 50.4' S, 174° 46.2' E

tabs_selector.custom_list_creation: Plus '+' button modal to add new skipper-defined custom checklist

emergency_scripts.mayday: Emergency Red heavy contrast modal & card with voice script pre-filled with Vessel, Callsign, GPS, and Mayday protocol steps
emergency_scripts.panpan: Urgency Amber heavy contrast modal & card with official radio script pre-filled with Vessel, Callsign, and GPS

export_system.print_layout: Lamination-ready print view (@media print), one list per page with vessel details header, checkbox circles, and skipper signoff line

pwa_and_offline.outbox_banner: Outbox: N unsynced changes banner displayed when offline
pwa_and_offline.toast_notifications: Sonner toast notifications on sync status and list actions

image_urls.description: Sailboat helm and ocean horizon hero visual
Marine fleet on water background accent

instructions_to_main_agent: Rebuild My Boat Prep as a clean, high-contrast, phone-first PWA marine checklist app. Ensure all 11 built-in lists are available with full edit/add/delete/tick/reset features, emergency Mayday/Pan Pan scripts auto-formatted with live GPS and boat detail bar values, lamination-ready print export layout, offline status banner, and strict data-testid attributes for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure minimum touch targets of 48x48px across all checklist checkboxes and buttons.
Do NOT use universal transition all.
Always include data-testid on every interactive element using kebab-case role-based names.
Ensure sunlight readability with high APCA contrast ratios and crisp borders.
Sonner for toasts via /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or toast utility.
